entities.summary: The Mitsubishi K3M  was a trainer built by Mitsubishi which was used by the Imperial Japanese Navy in an extremely wide variety of roles, including light transport, liaison aircraft, utility aircraft, and occasionally light bomber. Its Allied reporting name was Pine.
